method_analysis.output: closed-form baseline estimates μ-hat_i and triggering-kernel functions g-hat_ij(s).
method_analysis.state: No iterative optimizer state; sufficient matrix objects are Xi, concatenated feature map phi-tilde, and one MU×MU linear system.
method_analysis.objective: exact least-squares contrast L_LS plus γ^{-1} sum of squared RKHS norms.
assumptions: positive semidefinite k on compact one-dimensional T

claim_closure.claim: exact penalized least-squares Hawkes objective admits a transformed-kernel representer theorem with all dual coefficients equal to 1.

claim_closure.experimental_design_response: Experiments use the resulting closed-form Ours estimator; theorem identity itself is not empirically re-tested.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Appendix B/C derive the same Fredholm system and index-independent h_j.

claim_closure.appendix_response: Appendix B pp.15–16 and C pp.16–17.

evidence.anchor: dual coefficients are equal to unity

claim_closure.claim: baseline intensities and triggering kernels have computable closed forms under a degenerate/random-feature kernel.
claim_closure.theory_response: Appendices D–F prove all three propositions.
claim_closure.experimental_design_response: M=100 QMC features instantiate the formulas.
claim_closure.evidence_response: All Ours experiments execute the estimator.
claim_closure.ablation_response: No sensitivity to M or feature family.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion calls it a feasible kernel estimator.

evidence.anchor: obtained in closed form in terms of the feature maps

claim_closure.claim: equivalent kernels exist and are unique for any positive semidefinite k and γ>0.
claim_closure.theory_response: Appendix G proves Xi PSD and γ^{-1}I+Xi positive definite/invertible.

claim_closure.claim: Ours scales better with data size than Bonnet while avoiding iterative dual optimization and discretization.
claim_closure.method_response: Complexity O(N²M²U²+M³U³), memory O(M²U²), one MU-sized inverse.
claim_closure.theory_response: Complexity expression is stated, not proved with implementation-level constants.
claim_closure.experimental_design_response: Tables 1–2 vary T to 7000; Appendix H.1 extends T to 15000.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Ours is hundreds-fold faster than Bonnet in all reported settings.
claim_closure.ablation_response: Data-size scaling present; cross-hardware scaling absent.

claim_closure.method_response: Estimator and clipping rule are specified.
claim_closure.theory_response: No learning guarantee or risk bound.
claim_closure.experimental_design_response: Two synthetic scenarios plus one financial dataset and four baselines.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Comparable to Bonnet only in larger synthetic data; Ber has lower real-data nll point estimate; Ours is worse in small/refractory accuracy.
claim_closure.ablation_response: Grid refinement rules out coarse Ours tuning as the sole gap explanation.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 观察 Hawkes events 后，exact penalized L_LS 的 stationarity 不需要 data-sized dual optimization：它诱导一组 Fredholm-transformed equivalent kernels，所有 dual coefficients 固定为 1；random features 再把积分系统化为一个 MU-sized linear solve。[p.3 | §2.2 | “dual coefficients are equal to unity” | explicit；p.5 | Proposition 4 | “obtained in closed form” | explicit]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 objective、Theorem 1 statement/proof sketch、μ/g closed forms、random-feature integrals、N/U complexity、四张决策表、clipping 与 learning-guarantee boundary，因此读者可以判断机制与主要 tradeoff。[pp.3–10 | §2.2–§5 | Eq.(3)–(20), Tables 1–4 | layout_observation]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix 移入 full proofs、existence、kernel-shape figures、高 N/U scaling、grid sensitivity、CG negative result 与 Δ²–nll relation；理论 rigor 和高维适用边界依赖附录，核心 estimator 仍可由正文重建。[pp.14–23 | Appendix A–H | Figures 1–3, Tables 5–8 | layout_observation]
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效模式是「Theorem 1 的 unit coefficients → Proposition 3/4 的 MU×MU solve → Table 1/2 的 accuracy/runtime 双指标」：同一计算机制在公式、复杂度和结果中连续回收。[p.3 | Theorem 1 | “coefficients are equal to unity” | explicit；p.5 | Proposition 4 | Eq.(17) | explicit；pp.8–9 | Tables 1–2 | layout_observation]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大未闭合处是 statistical learning guarantee；实证 generality 也受单一 real dataset、固定 M=100、缺 seeds 与 Ber outlier denominator 不明限制。accuracy–prediction relation 同时改变 T，不能识别因果作用。[p.10 | Limitations | “learning guarantees is beyond the scope” | explicit；p.9 | §4.1.2 | “outlier samples were excluded” | explicit；p.23 | H.4 | Table 8 | interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 理论论文若以表示定理解释加速，应在正文把结构性消除项、可执行 closed form、复杂度依赖和同一 baselines 下的 accuracy–runtime tradeoff 连成一条链，完整证明与 scale extensions 再入附录。[pp.3–8 | Theorem 1 → Proposition 4 → Table 1 | “dual coefficients are equal to unity” | interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该模式适用于 theorem 直接改变算法状态空间或 optimization dimension 的工作；若核心贡献是 finite-sample efficacy、robustness 或 deployment safety，full evidence 不能只由 algebraic closure 与 runtime tables 代替。[p.10 | Limitations | “learning guarantees is beyond the scope” | interpretation]

evidence_coverage.counting_rule: 递归计数带非空 evidence 的对象，并另计 final_judgment 中内嵌页码/章节锚点的 7 项；missing-status 项不作实质判断计数。
